correctness.rationale: Standard Picard classes provide all 27 geometric lines; all 72 sixers give 36 distinct double-sixes, independently reconstructed from the 36 opposite E6 root pairs. Exact 432-incidence degrees yield a 63-vertex Laplacian; the Gram cubic and trace yield a connected spectrum and Kirchhoff determinant 2^96 3^53 5^20. Exact p-adic elimination for p=2,3,5 on two distinct deleted-vertex minors gives all local elementary divisors, agreeing with determinant exponents. The full standard-library code is embedded and was executed successfully. No infinite proof rests solely on sampling: geometric uniformity uses the classical blow-up classification.

value.rationale: The 27-line/36-double-six incidence is a natural Weyl-homogeneous cubic-surface configuration, and the complete integral graph critical group is a motivated integral divisor-class invariant, not merely a restatement of rational spectral or saturation data. Its 50 nontrivial factors and large 2-primary part expose information invisible in the known rectangular incidence Smith form and in the graph tree count. The exact complete finite classification has standalone reusable value for incidence/chip-firing studies. This is not an identification with the surface Picard group.
